verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents prebuilt per-project dashboards that include token usage, plus custom chart collections that can be grouped by run tag or metadata. Cost is a tracked metric, since alerts can fire on cost thresholds. However, the evidence never explicitly shows cost charts in dashboards or breakdowns by request, model, or time period. missing for 10: explicit cost charts in dashboards, documented per-model breakdown, per-request cost/token view, time-period filtering, independent corroboration.
